# SmallPush

> Digital Consultancy & Tech Partner specialized in CiviCRM, Drupal, Spanish Payment Gateways (Redsys, Stripe, SEPA), Tax Automation (Modelo 182), and AI Solutions for Non-Profits (NGOs), Foundations, and Social Impact Organizations.

SmallPush provides end-to-end digital engineering and growth strategies for non-governmental organizations (NGOs), non-profits, civic projects, and political parties. We specialize in centralizing member/donor management, automating donation workflows, integrating Spanish & European payment ecosystems, and deploying intelligent AI agents (RAG / LLMs) into social impact workflows.

## Key Services & Engineering Capabilities

- **CiviCRM Deployment & Architecture**: Custom implementation, membership management, donor funnels, CiviRules automation, deduplication, and high-performance database tuning.
- **Drupal Development**: Custom web portals, intranet integration, member portals, and seamless bidirectional synchronization with CiviCRM.
- **Payment Gateways & SEPA**: Direct integration of CiviCRM and web forms with Redsys (Spain), Stripe, PayPal, and SEPA direct debit files for recurring donor subscription management.
- **Fiscal Models Automation (AEAT Spain)**: Automatic generation of "Modelo 182" tax certificates for tax deduction reporting to the Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Tributaria).
- **AI Agents & RAG Integration**: Implementation of LLM-powered virtual assistants (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) for automated supporter onboarding, FAQ resolution, and CRM lead qualification.

## Core Pages & Tools

- [SmallPush Home Page](https://smallpush.org): Main portal outlining core services, AI integration, and quote calculator for non-profits.
- [Donor Funnel Solution](https://smallpush.org/donor-funnel): Specialized acquisition and donation funnel design to maximize recurring donor conversion for NGOs.
- [Event Funnel Solution](https://smallpush.org/event-funnel): Turnkey event registration, ticketing, and participant tracking integrated with CiviCRM.
- [Technical Blog & Articles](https://smallpush.org/news): Technical guides, benchmarks, and best practices for CiviCRM, Drupal, and AI programming.

## Featured Technical Articles & Case Studies

- [Payment Methods in CiviCRM: Integration Guide](https://smallpush.org/news/civicrm-payment-methods): Integrating Stripe, Redsys, PayPal, and SEPA Direct Debit for non-profits.
- [5 Essential CiviCRM Automations for Nonprofits](https://smallpush.org/news/civicrm-essential-automations): Automated scheduled reminders, member renewals, and failed payment recovery workflows using CiviRules.
- [CiviCRM 6.11: AI Agent Architectures & Predictive Intelligence](https://smallpush.org/news/civicrm-agents-architecture): Transforming relational CRM databases into predictive engines using Vector DBs and LLM orchestration.
- [CiviCRM Hosting: Google Cloud vs AWS](https://smallpush.org/news/civicrm-hosting-comparison): Technical comparison of GCP vs AWS for hosting CiviCRM workloads.
- [Optimizing CiviCRM Performance & Database Tuning](https://smallpush.org/news/civicrm-tuning): InnoDB buffer pool tuning, MySQL optimization, and query scaling for large donor bases.
- [CiviCRM Data Quality & Deduplication Guide](https://smallpush.org/news/civicrm-data-quality-deduplication): Configuring deduplication rules, resolving duplicate contacts, and cleaning CSV import data.
- [Automating Social Ads to CRM Lead Capture](https://smallpush.org/news/social-ads-crm-integration): Importing lead ads from Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn directly into CiviCRM.
- [Specification-Driven Development (SDD) in AI Programming](https://smallpush.org/news/sdd-ai-programming): Modern AI software engineering paradigm using detailed specification files.
